title: The Quiet Choir
author: Edmund Amberdale
blurb: Cyrus Montrose, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
